_source: Mongoose Traveller 2e Core Rulebook Update 2022, printed pp40-41 (pdf 33-34)
name: Rogue
blurb: Criminal elements familiar with the rougher or more illegal methods of attaining goals.
_pension_note: Rogue is one of the careers excluded from pensions (with Scout, Prisoner and Drifter).

assignments.name: Thief
assignments.desc: You steal from the rich and give to... well, yourself, actually.

assignments.name: Enforcer
assignments.desc: You are a leg breaker, thug or assassin for a criminal group.

skill_tables._advanced_education_note: Requires EDU 10+, as with Citizen and Entertainer -- not the usual 8+.

_cash_note: Rolls 1 and 2 on the Cash column read 'None' in the book, as with Drifter and Entertainer.
_benefit_note: Rogue is the only career whose benefits grant a VARIABLE number of Ship Shares (1D on a 4, 2D on a 7).

mishaps.text: Severely injured (as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
Arrested. You must take the Prisoner career in your next term.

Betrayed by a friend. One of your Contacts or Allies betrays you, ending your career; that Contact or Ally becomes a Rival or Enemy. If you have none, you are betrayed by someone you never saw coming and still gain a Rival or Enemy. In addition, roll 2D; on a 2 you must take the Prisoner career next term.
A job goes wrong, forcing you to flee off-planet. Gain one of Deception 1, Pilot (small craft or spacecraft) 1, Athletics (dexterity) 1 or Gunner 1.
A police detective or rival criminal forces you to flee and vows to hunt you down. Gain an Enemy.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.text: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table, but you are not ejected from this career.

You are arrested and charged. Defend yourself or hire a lawyer. If you defend yourself, roll Advocate 8+: on success the charges are dropped; on failure gain an Enemy and take the Prisoner career next term. If you hired a lawyer, gain the lawyer as a Contact and lose a Benefit roll.
You are involved in the planning of an impressive heist. Gain Electronics 1 or Mechanic 1.
One of your crimes pays off. Gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll and gain your victim as an Enemy.
You have the opportunity to backstab a fellow rogue for personal gain. If you do so, gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll. If you refuse, gain them as an Ally.
Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
You spend months in the dangerous criminal underworld. Gain one of Streetwise 1, Stealth 1, Melee 1 or Gun Combat 1.
You become involved in a feud with a rival criminal organisation. Roll Stealth or Gun Combat 8+; on failure roll on the Injury table, on success gain an extra Benefit roll.

You are involved in a gambling ring. Gain Gambler 1. You may wager any number of Benefit rolls and roll Gambler 8+; on failure lose all the wagered Benefit rolls, on success gain half as many Benefit rolls as you wagered, rounding up.
A crime lord considers you his protege. Either gain Tactics (military) 1 or DM+4 to your next advancement roll thanks to their aid.
You commit a legendary crime. You are automatically promoted.
